text:
Incident Bot: SEV2 alert — p99 latency > 5s in router-usw2, streaming stalls noticed, ~32% requests affected. Automated SLO alert fired. Paging oncall.
Maya (oncall): seeing it, acked. pulling up dashboards now. p95 ~1.4s -> 2.0s, p99 jumped to 6.5s on router-ingress in US-WEST-2.
Raj P: looking at routing-telemetry, I see a concentrated spike to a single backend shard group (zone-b) — hot partitioning. traffic weight shifted recently.
Kevin R: any recent deploys to routing policy?
Maya (oncall): yes, routing-policy v12 rolled 05:12 UTC (canary -> full) per release log.
Sarah L: that's the rollout I shipped yesterday (traffic steering by prefix). I can revert if that's the cause.
Tomas (eng-ml): streaming stalls look correlated with KV cache misses for long-context sessions hitting the same shard key. logs: ````
[router] ERROR route-miss key="user:hotkey-7f3b" latency=7832ms route=zone-b
[runtime] tail-stall seq=2048 kv-cache-miss=true model=redwood-13b-q4
````
Raj P: big red flag: route weights for zone-b jumped from 10% -> 72% after v12 rollout. that's a classic hotspot.
Maya (oncall): action plan: 1) revert v12 rollout (quick toggle) 2) apply temporary rate-limit per-key 3) enable eager fallback to smaller model for streaming requests 4) block hot key if necessary. I'll coordinate.
Maya (oncall): rolling back routing-policy v12 now: `infractl routing rollback --policy routing-policy-v12 --env prod --region usw2`
Incident Bot: Rollback initiated by Maya at 05:57 UTC.
Sarah L: confirming rollback step. running validation check on routing table after toggle.
Raj P: while rollback is in progress, add per-key rate limit: `routerctl ratelimit add --key-prefix user:hotkey-7f3b --qps 5 --region usw2`
Kevin R: enabling eager fallback to compact model for streaming sessions: `runtimectl set-fallback --from redwood-13b-q4 --to redwood-3b-q4 --region usw2 --mode eager`
Julia (cust-succ): FYI we have two customers complaining about timeouts on streaming in US-WEST-2 (support tickets #11234, #11237). I can notify them once we have a short summary.
Maya (oncall): rollback completed, routing weights converging to expected baseline. patch verified via `infractl routing status --policy routing-policy-v12 --region usw2` shows weights ~ 11/11/12 across zones.
Raj P: telemetry after rollback: p99 dropped from 6.5s -> 2.1s within 3 minutes. streaming stall count down 80%.
Tomas (eng-ml): cache warming in progress; KV hit-rate trending up.
Kevin R: rate-limit and eager fallback active. we've blacklisted one hot key temporarily: `routerctl hotkey block --key user:hotkey-7f3b --duration 30m --region usw2`
Sarah L: logging the immediate mitigations in the incident runbook. I'll prepare a revert/rollforward plan for v12 with narrower canary and additional telemetry hooks.
Maya (oncall): customer update drafted: "We experienced increased tail latency affecting streaming responses in US-WEST-2 due to an automated routing policy rollout. We rolled back the policy and applied temporary mitigations; service performance is restored. Root-cause investigation is underway." @Julia can you send?
Julia (cust-succ): will send now and mark affected customers.
Raj P: next steps for eng-runtime: reproduce locally with traffic replay and add guard to rollout controller to cap per-route weight change to 20% per minute.
Tomas (eng-ml): also adding a hotkey detector on the router that auto-applies per-key QPS shields when a key exceeds threshold for p99 contribution.
Kevin R: adding follow-up action: run a simulation of v12 in staging with synthetic hotkey traffic.
Maya (oncall): handing off to Raj P for the detailed postmortem and long-term fixes. I'm stepping off oncall at 07:15 UTC — leaving these notes: rollback succeeded, mitigations applied (ratelimit + fallback + hotkey block), customers notified.
Raj P: taking ownership. moving to postmortem phase. I'll open an internal ticket with timeline + metrics + proposed fix (routing rollout damping + hotkey auto-shield + improved canary telemetry).
Incident Bot: SEV2 -> monitoring. Incident duration 1h 36m. Attachments: perf graphs, trace IDs included in thread.
Maya (oncall): thanks team. small note: we should update the rollout runbook to include a quick rollback command snippet and a checklist for per-key shields. :thumbsup:
Sarah L: agree. I'll add the checklist and small test to PR for the rollout controller.
Raj P: leaving a checkpoint: collect traces for trace IDs shown earlier, add to ticket.
Julia (cust-succ): sent customer emails, included support ticket IDs and ETA for full RCA (48h).
Maya (oncall): closing handoff. if perf regresses reopen this thread.
Raj P: noted. will post the postmortem draft in #postmortems by EOD.
Incident Bot: Thread archived when resolved.
